scope: Complete supplied four-page main, three figures, Table 1, two equations and 15-reference bibliography; SI not located/read and cited full sources unreviewed.

bibliographic_scope.title: Solvothermal Synthesis of Nanocrystalline MoS2 from MoO3 and Elemental Sulfur
bibliographic_scope.authors: J. H. Zhan; Z. D. Zhang; X. F. Qian; C. Wang; Y. Xie; Y. T. Qian

interpretations.topic: Sulfur ratio selects oxide, mixed phase or disulfide
interpretations.text: Under the reported 300 °C, 12 h solvothermal conditions, Table 1 and Figure 1 assign MoO2 to the no-sulfur feed, MoO2 + MoS2 to MoO3:S = 1:1, and MoS2 to 1:2 and 1:3. The typical 1:2 feed contains 0.576 g (4 mmol) MoO3 and 8 mmol sulfur; the printed sulfur number 0.256 lacks a mass unit. Other ratios do not establish their own absolute precursor charges.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–3, Preparation, Figure 1 and Table 1

interpretations.topic: Phase identification and composition remain distinct
interpretations.text: The two sulfur-rich products are indexed as 2H-MoS2, space group P63/mmc (194), with (002), (100), (103) and (110) reflections. Chemical analysis reports MoS1.99 for 1:2 and MoS2.02 for 1:3. These are chemical-analysis compositions, not refined site occupancies or a measure of interfacial geometry.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, XRD and chemical-analysis discussion

interpretations.topic: Study-wide dimensions are not two separately measured batches
interpretations.text: The paper reports refined a = 3.16 Å and c = 12.40 Å and describes thin platelets around 100 nm. Figure 2b is an individual particle about 200 nm across. The text does not uniquely map those observations to ratio c or d; the individual particle is not a second population mean. Reference-card values a0 = 3.1616 Å and c0 = 12.2985 Å are literature comparison data, not new measurements.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, XRD refinement paragraph and Figure 2

interpretations.topic: IR supports the authors’ no-intercalation interpretation
interpretations.text: The prose assigns an IR band at 382 cm⁻¹; Figure 3 labels 382.8. The reported absence of bands from 500 to 4000 cm⁻¹ is interpreted by the authors as no guest pyridine between the MoS2 layers. This is their spectral interpretation, not a quantitative limit on every possible impurity. The analyzed ratio-specific batch is not identified.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 3 and IR discussion

interpretations.text: The authors propose reduction of MoO3 to MoO2 by hydrazine, followed by sulfidation to MoS2. Adding sufficient sulfur to the mixed 1:1 product and replacing MoO3 with MoO2 are reported to yield MoS2, but those supporting tests lack separate charge and schedule details. Equations 1 and 2 are proposed reaction steps, not measured transient concentrations.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Mechanistic discussion and equations 1–2

interpretations.text: Below 250 °C the reaction requires a long time; above 350 °C pyridine may decompose without greatly improving MoS2 crystallinity. Exact temperature series and durations are not supplied. The authors choose 300 °C for 12 h and describe pyridine as heat-stable at the chosen conditions, sulfur-solubilizing and miscible with hydrazine. Lubrication suitability is a proposed application; no functional performance test is reported.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3–4, Temperature discussion and conclusion

limitations: Complete supplied four-page main; no matching local SI located/read. Cited full sources, including chemical-analysis reference 14, are unreviewed.
Only the 1:2 recipe has explicit absolute MoO3 and sulfur charges. Other ratios inherit the stated same conditions, not an invented common precursor amount.
Sulfur is printed as 0.256 (8 mmol), without a mass unit; retain 8 mmol and the unitless original number without asserting 0.256 g.
The source prints sliver-lined stainless steel autoclave. Lining identity is not silently corrected; capacity is 30 mL, and 70% is total vessel fill, not pyridine volume.
Temperature ramp, autogenous pressure, stirring, collection technique, water doses, vacuum pressure and storage are unreported.
Figures 2 and 3, refined cell constants and the abstract yield do not explicitly identify a ratio-specific batch. These are separate study-wide contexts, not duplicated measurements for c and d.
No atomic coordinates, refined atomic model, interface geometry or functional lubrication/catalysis performance is supplied.
Independent source audit passed; presentation remains pending.
